200.description: Full masked Thing snapshots; event: thing.snapshot; id: revision. Reconnect sends current persisted state.
Active conversation snapshots (conversation.snapshot) and text deltas (conversation.delta). Reconnect restores saved messages and current transient text; deltas include message ID and offset.

get.description: Authenticated SSE: conversation.snapshot contains Conversation; conversation.delta contains ConversationDelta (message ID, text offset). Snapshots replace local state on reconnect. Failed messages retry with the same request ID.

Error.description: Public failure message and HTTP status; private diagnostic details are omitted.

Money.description: Amount in integer minor units and a supported currency with two decimal places.

Value.description: A stored scalar or money value. Identifiers retain their string representation.

NullableValue.description: A field value, or null for an empty, cleared or masked field.

SourceRef.description: Attachment or public URL supporting a value; quotes may be omitted for sensitive fields.

Pin.description: Reference to a field within its set, a standalone field, or a custom field.

FieldSchema.description: Supported JSON Schema subset used to validate registry field values.

FieldDefinition.description: Authored registry definition reused across categories and field sets.

Field.description: A field definition with its current value, provenance and masking state.

FieldSet.description: Category-specific field group with required and suggested related sets.

DetailFieldSet.description: Selected field set expanded with current field values.

UndefinedField.description: Owner-specific custom field preserving data without a registry definition.

Category.description: Authored Thing category with owner-scoped Thing count.

Profile.description: Authenticated owner profile and sample-data status.

Config.description: Public client configuration and feature availability; contains no server credentials.

Tag.description: Owner-defined label used to organise Things.

TagInput.description: Name for an owner-scoped tag; whitespace-only names are rejected.

ThingSummary.description: Public Thing metadata excluding stored field values.

Thing.description: Owner-scoped Thing detail with masked fields, links and current import state.

ValuePatch.description: Set or standalone field update; null clears the stored value.

UndefinedPatch.description: Custom field update retaining its identity and sensitivity.

ThingCreate.description: Initial Thing metadata and optional field, tag and pin selections.

ThingPatch.description: Specified Thing updates, merged under a lock while preserving other values.

RevealRequest.description: Field reference for an explicit owner-authorised sensitive-value read.

RevealResult.description: Revealed field value; responses must not be cached.

Attachment.description: Private attachment metadata and linked Things; excludes storage keys.

Issue.description: Problem associated with one Thing, including resolution state.

IssueInput.description: New Thing issue; defaults to OPEN.

IssuePatch.description: Specified issue updates; resolving retains the first resolution timestamp.

Event.description: Suggested or scheduled Thing task with lifecycle timestamps and provenance.

EventInput.description: New Thing event; SCHEDULED requires a start time.

EventPatch.description: Specified event updates; null clears optional links or dates.

Purchasable.description: Cited consumable, accessory or upgrade suggestion; sample actions are disabled.

Message.description: Persisted conversation message with intent, citations, cards and execution state.

Conversation.description: Active owner-scoped conversation and its persisted messages.

ConversationInput.description: Optional Thing context for a new conversation.

CategoryList.description: Paginated category results and an opaque continuation cursor.

FieldSetList.description: Paginated field set results and an opaque continuation cursor.

FieldDefinitionList.description: Paginated field definition results and an opaque continuation cursor.

ThingSummaryList.description: Paginated thing summary results and an opaque continuation cursor.

TagList.description: Paginated tag results and an opaque continuation cursor.

AttachmentList.description: Paginated attachment results and an opaque continuation cursor.

IssueList.description: Paginated issue results and an opaque continuation cursor.

EventList.description: Paginated event results and an opaque continuation cursor.

PurchasableList.description: Paginated purchasable results and an opaque continuation cursor.

ImportCandidate.description: Detected Thing offered for owner confirmation.

ImportUsage.description: Provider usage and bounded tool execution totals for an attempt.

Import.description: Public import state excluding raw extraction and private source content.

ImportStart.description: Source attachment and optional existing Thing to enrich.

ImportAccepted.description: Queued import identity and initial Thing identity.

ImportConfirmation.description: Selected detected candidates and their optional existing targets.

ResourceCard.description: Typed reference to an owned resource; availability reflects current access.

MessageInput.description: Idempotent message request with explicit authorisation intent for write tools.

ConversationDelta.description: Transient text update identified by message and text offset.

Unauthorized.description: A valid bearer token is required.

NotFound.description: The resource is missing, inaccessible or disabled.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with current state or an existing record.

TooLarge.description: The uploaded file exceeds the configured limit.

UnsupportedMedia.description: The file or request media type is unsupported.

InvalidInput.description: The request or a referenced value is invalid.

Unavailable.description: The requested capability is not configured or available.

ServerError.description: The request failed; private diagnostics are omitted.
